text:
A: Hiya! Can you hear me alright? I'm Yusuf.
B: Yeah, fine. Craig.
A: Craig, nice one. Where are you, mate?
B: Leigh. Near Wigan.
A: Oh, you're the rugby lot then. Gemma was saying about all that, Wigan this, Warriors that.
B: Yeah, she's on the wrong side. Leigh Leopards. We had a chat about it.
A: Ha. I'm Villa. Football. What do you do?
B: Instrument tech, water treatment works near Warrington. I'm on call this week, so if my phone goes I'll have to go.
A: What, like proper emergencies?
B: Sometimes. Mostly a sensor playing up at three in the morning. You go out, fix it, come home.
A: Three in the morning, mate. I'd be useless. I'm an exec assistant, two directors at a property firm in Birmingham. Diaries, lunches, travel. Honestly the worst thing that happens to me is a restaurant losing a booking. Which I then have to explain. Creatively.
B: Creatively.
A: I've already been caught out twice today on that, so I'm not saying any more.
B: Fair enough.
A: Your flat looks cosy. Is that your little one in the photo?
B: Ruby, yeah. She's four. That's Tenby, that, on the beach. Last summer.
A: Lovely. And it's your place, yeah?
B: Renting. We want to buy, but you know. Not yet.
A: Same, we're renting in the Jewellery Quarter. Me and my girlfriend. Birmingham prices are mad.
B: Everywhere's mad.
A: You play any football yourself?
B: Five-a-side, Wednesdays, with lads from work. When they turn up.
A: No way, I'm Wednesdays as well. With my old school mates. I'm loud, I'll be honest, I'm louder than I am good. But I bring the energy.
B: Every team's got one.
A: Every team needs one, mate. Do you know what I mean.
B: I'm the one stood at the back not tracking back. Had a lad from Wolverhampton telling me off about that earlier.
A: Wolves fan? I've not had him yet. I saw his scarf on the photo, that's a problem straight away.
B: He was alright. Called a barm a bap, mind.
A: Mate, it is a bap. Gemma tried this on me as well, the pie barm thing.
B: It's a barm.
A: It's a bap. I'll say barm in Wigan, I'll say bap in Brum.
B: That's diplomatic.
A: That's my job, to be fair. Making everyone happy.
B: Suppose it is. I just fix pumps.
A: Honestly, that sounds more useful. Nobody's flooding cos I booked the wrong Lebanese place.
